features.name: Synthetic data boundary and protected runtime
in: Owner-provided app/data/synthetic.json
Fresh Zoho accounts and credentials configured in app/.env
APP_LIVE setting
out: Startup validation and data_rejected evidence
Test-recipient enforcement until APP_LIVE=true
Domain suppression and audit events
No payment, transfer, or bank-write capability
features.done-check: Invalid fixture data prevents startup and records data_rejected; all fixture email and WhatsApp identities satisfy the spec; pre-live sends are restricted to configured test recipients; declined organization domains are suppressed; secret scan passes; inspection of Books writes finds no money-movement or bank-write calls.

features.name: Commercial loop intake and state
serves: spec pinned words Loop, Cold, Touch
spec §3 Zoho Mail, WhatsApp and synthetic inputs
in: Mail threads
Inbound WhatsApp messages and voice notes
Orders from email, WhatsApp, and stall
Synthetic orgs, people, orders, and stall days
out: Persistent loops with type, counterpart, last touch, next move, and due time
Reply and owner-action updates
Order-to-ship loops; shipping closes the loop
features.done-check: Lead, sample-out, quote, unconfirmed-order, and order-to-ship loops are created and updated from the specified channels; qualifying touches reset cold timing; shipping closes its order loop; an unapproved draft remains unsent and recurs in a later brief.

features.name: Timed briefs, drafts, and owner approvals
serves: spec pinned words Cold, Brief, Approve, Touch
in: Open loops and their histories
Owner approval by tap, reply, or voice note
Configured WhatsApp test channel and email accounts
out: 08:00 and 18:00 Europe/London WhatsApp briefs
Channel-appropriate drafts with approve/edit/drop actions
Logged approval, transcript, send, and reply events
features.done-check: Cold loops appear in scheduled briefs; only a tap or affirmative reply/transcript authorizes sending; a voice-note refusal sends nothing; tap approval sends the draft on the counterpart channel and resets touch; soft no closes only that loop; exactly two scheduled briefs occur in a 24-hour check and no unprompted owner message is sent between them.

features.name: Invoice follow-up and payment closure
in: Zoho Books invoices, due dates, payments, and invoice loops
out: Overdue invoice loop and chase draft naming invoice and amount
Payment-driven loop closure
features.done-check: An unpaid invoice one day overdue appears in the next brief with invoice number and amount; recording its payment in Books closes the loop by the next brief cycle and prevents later chase drafts.

features.name: Receipt capture and approved expense entry
in: Receipt photo or forwarded receipt email over WhatsApp
Owner approval
out: Extracted supplier and amount for confirmation
Approved Zoho Books expense and books_write evidence
features.done-check: A receipt photo produces a reviewable supplier and amount; an expense with those values is written to the fresh Zoho Books account only after owner approval, with its Books id recorded.

features.name: Stall cash-up and stock movement

in: WhatsApp voice note with bag count, size, lot, and cash amount
Meta voice transcription
Owner approval
out: Read-back of interpreted cash-up
Approved Books sale
Stock movement and stall-day cash-up state
features.done-check: Six 250g bags of lot 2 for £120 create an approved £120 sale and reduce lot 2 by exactly 1.5kg; missing bag size prompts for it and causes no Books write until supplied; interpretation is read back before approval.

features.name: Lot balances and reorder loops
in: Lot start and remaining kg
Approved stock movements
Loop store
out: Current kg balance per lot
Reorder loop below 20% of starting quantity
Lot values for the overview page
features.done-check: Every lot balance reflects approved movements; a lot below 20% of starting kg has a lot_low loop and appears in the next brief.

features.name: Lead qualification, network, and warm introductions
serves: spec pinned words Specialty bar, Warm path
spec §3 lead websites and public Instagram
in: Synthetic organizations, people, and network edges
Lead shop page and public Instagram profile read once
Open enrichment access decision
out: Qualified lead with price, tier, Indian coffee flag, and source for each fact
Below-bar closure with reason
One- and two-edge network paths and ordered lead priority
Warm-path draft naming connection and separately approved introducer draft
features.done-check: Price below £8 closes the lead with reason and prevents drafting; £8–£12 is mid-shelf and above £12 premium; Indian coffee status and source URLs are recorded; one-edge leads rank before two-edge leads before strangers; warm drafts name the shared connection and propose an introducer without sending absent its own approval.

features.name: Where I stand dashboard and lead background
in: Fresh Zoho Books balances and invoices
Loop store and lot balances
Organizations, edges, and lead qualification sources
out: One web page showing cash, owed, kg per lot, loops due today, and network map
Expandable lead background panel with sourced facts and network path
features.done-check: The map includes every synthetic organization and edge; the expandable panel shows tier, price, Indian-on-shelf status, path, and source for each fact; displayed cash, owed, lot kg, and due loops match Zoho Books and the loop store at read time; the page is read-only except approvals.
features.render_verification: Nine isolated Playwright browser checks passed: sign-in, edit then approve one test send, shipment closure across reload, network selection, 1440px desktop and 390px/320px phone widths, London timestamps, zero final console errors. No connected provider proof. Cases: checks/browser-smoke.mjs.

features.name: Action evidence and operational safeguards
in: Brief, approval, message, Books, validation, suppression, and loop events
out: Timestamped app/logs/actions.jsonl records sufficient to reconcile each run
features.done-check: Every brief, approval, transcript, send, Books write, stock movement, blocked/suppressed event, and rejected dataset has a timestamped, attributable action-log record with identifiers needed by the stated checks.
features.implementation_notes: Explicit failure states, immutable approvals, persisted write intents, complete test-only harness, sanitized evidence and transaction-aware action log.

in: Owner click on Where I stand
DEMO_AGE_DAYS
out: Composed brief (summary + up to 5 cards) returned to the page
Optional WhatsApp delivery
brief line with manual:true
features.done-check: Owner can compose the brief at any time without sending; sending delivers one summary plus one card per action; manual briefs are labelled and do not count toward the two scheduled slots; demo clock ages loops for cold checks only.

features.name: Owner intent on WhatsApp: natural approve, edit, ask
in: Owner text or voice transcript, with or without a quoted card
out: intent audit line
approve / drop / edit / cashup / receipt / ask routing
Answer from loops, Books and stock
New card after an edit
features.done-check: A natural yes on a quoted card sends once; confidence under 0.8 sends nothing; an edit raises the version and rebinds a new card; a question is answered without any send or write; exact yes needs no model call.

features.name: Event vocabulary: host and revoked lines
in: Every provider request
Every revoked pending action
out: host line per outbound request (host, method only)
revoked line per action with loop id and reason
app-spec.json event list matching evals.md

features.name: Loop model: stage, chases, reserved kg

Owner statement or counterpart touch that completes a stage
Approved sends and counterpart touches
out: stage on every loop with a typed counterpart, from the roaster, café or stockist sequence
stage line on each completion with from, completed and to
chases counts approved sends since the last counterpart touch; reserved_kg on order loops
features.done-check: A café lead starts at intro; completing sample moves it to guest slot offer with a stage line; two approved sends then a counterpart touch leave chases at 0; a stage outside the sequence is rejected.

features.name: Capture: one owner message into many items
in: Owner text or transcript classified as capture
Forwarded WhatsApp messages (context.forwarded)
Organisations and lots in the store
out: capture line listing every item with type, loop id, duplicate flag and missing fields
one read-back message; at most one ask naming the fields an order or receipt needs
order, sample, lead, chase, stall and receipt loops; thread_append on the matching loop for forwarded messages
a stub lead org for a counterpart the data does not hold
features.done-check: Four items in one voice note give one capture line with four items, one read-back naming all four and one ask for the lot; the same order twice is one loop with duplicate: true on the second capture; a forwarded message appends to the matching loop or opens one and nothing is drafted to the forwarded party.

features.name: Voice file gate and thread-aware drafts
serves: spec Pinned: In the owner's voice

Inbound counterpart messages stored on the loop thread at receive
Owner sends appended to the thread on completion

features.name: Price list guard and offer ladder
in: app/data/terms.md price rows, stall bag prices, cadence and the Never line (TERMS_FILE overrides the path for checks)
Every model draft before it becomes a card
out: src/terms.mjs: parseTerms, loadTerms, checkDraft

The hold clears when the next draft passes
features.done-check: The real terms.md parses to the Fusion Ferment row, £8 and £28 bags and 7/5-day cadence; [price per kg], £20/kg on Fusion Ferment and a 10% first-order discount block; £13.60/kg, the W7 pass example and a pallet discount pass; a blocked draft leaves no action and the brief says what is missing.

required_external_proof: Fresh Zoho Mail/Books accounts: verify actual test mail, approved expense and sale create/readback, invoice payment closure and current cash/invoice totals.
WhatsApp: verify configured test recipients, signed webhook hosting, actual brief delivery, owner tap/quoted reply/voice approval and closed-window approved templates.
Actual configured Meta text/vision model and Meta Voice service: verify real responses, source-backed facts and complete audio transcription.
Owner synthetic dataset review and provider record mappings; public shop allowlist and optional Instagram professional-account permissions.
Always-on public HTTPS hosting remains unselected; observe the real 08:00/18:00 Europe/London cycle for 24 hours.
Live use remains outside acceptance: verify current lawful basis and explicit owner authority before APP_LIVE=true.
